title: 07 Tessin & Ström: a risograph annual report section
industry: design research consultancy (B2B services, healthcare clients)
strengths: The technique carries the finding: pink is the felt wait (61 min), blue the actual (38), and the overprint is the part that was real; the same rule drives the before and pilot bars
Two spot inks only (Medium Blue, Fluorescent Pink) with misregistration, starved-ink voids and soft drum banding on solids, while small type stays crisp and readable
Report-grade content: 412 h in 14 waiting rooms, 1,860 timed waits, 96 and 88 exit interviews, -41% complaints, 4.1% to 1.6% left before being seen, and a method note with n values
slop_signals: The giant pink '61' and blue '38' overlap so the left half reads as '6138' at a glance
The grain is uniform digital noise on every solid; real riso shows drum banding, starved edges and uneven density
fixes: Overlap the numerals only at an edge, or stack them, so each number reads first and the overprint second
Use one scanned riso texture (licensed) or vary ink density per drum instead of a single noise filter

references.what: A before/after research finding with a bar chart and a link to the full report
Oversized statistics in different ink colours with a plain caption
Large figures with a small graphic that carries the number
